title: plan.md template teaches numbered Build order but gate requires '-' bullets — shipped template fails its own structural gate
repro: Copy prusik/templates/artifacts/plan.md Build order shape ('1. <step>'), run 'prusik gate plan' on it: build_order 'needs >=1 bullet items, got 0'. Template and schema disagree.

resolution.verify: CUR=$(prusik --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+' | head -1); [ -n "$CUR" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' '0.198.0' "$CUR" | sort -V | head -1)" = '0.198.0' ] && echo "1 passed: engine carries moat-proven fix fb-664f701dc005 (prusik $CUR >= 0.198.0)"
